'''Zombies''' can be found throughout the second layer of the [[Stronghold of Security]]. Some rooms are solely occupied by zombies, and others share the room with [[Flesh Crawler]]s. They can be decent training but are outclassed by Flesh Crawlers in terms of both drops and experience.
